verdict.line: You lose if you let her stack Test of Spirit procs and fight at full tentacle uptime before 6; you win once Unstoppable Force forces a bad trade or you reach Sunfire/Thornmail timing.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's W (Harsh Lesson) and passive Tentacles punish every short trade because Tentacles swing and heal her whenever she lands damage near them, so standing anywhere close to a wall is a loss. Malphite has no reliable way to out-damage that sustain pre-6, so this lane is about denying her Tentacle spawns and minion-tanking her E rather than brawling.

theirWindow.when: E lands and you're near a wall
theirWindow.what: If Test of Spirit hits you near impassable terrain she'll spawn a Tentacle and start free damage; back off the wall immediately and let the spirit timer expire without fighting near it, since the echoed damage and Tentacle swings stack fast.

yourWindow.when: Her E and Q are both down
yourWindow.what: With Tentacle Smash and Test of Spirit on cooldown she has no empowered damage source, so step up and take a trade with your own W (Brutal Strikes) active for the Armor/AD buff — this is your only safe window to actually hit her.

powerCurve.note: W empowers Tentacles immediately, you have nothing
E stacks snowball if you fight near walls
R threatens a knock-up, forces caution
teamfight R value outscales her 1v1 power

start.why: The passive block and extra regen directly offset the poke and Tentacle chip she generates every time you're near terrain, letting you hold position on minions instead of surrendering CS.

boots.why: Her W, auto-resets off Harsh Lesson, and Tentacle swings are all basic physical hits — the attack-damage reduction specifically blunts every one of those instances.

core.why: Gives you the HP and armor to actually stand in her E range and tank Tentacle procs instead of kiting, which is the only way to deny her sustain loop.
Illaoi's damage is entirely physical autos and W leaps — Thornmail's reflect punishes every engage she makes on you and the grievous wound cuts her Tentacle-fueled healing.
The attack speed slow on nearby enemies directly reduces how many W/auto resets she can land on you in extended trades.

situational.when: she's rushing lifesteal or healing items to sustain off Tentacle procs
she's building burst-adjacent magic pen or you need the shield reset to survive her R engage

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's proc rewards standing in minion-wave melee range, which is exactly where you need to be to deny her Test of Spirit setups — it heals you for holding the trade instead of running.

summoners.why: 48% of games run Flash/Teleport at 71.6% pick rate — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with W (Brutal Strikes) and avoid dying to a gank while you're near the wall denying her Tentacles.

playing.title: Never fight near walls
playing.detail: Every wall near the lane is a Tentacle spawn point for her passive and R — if Test of Spirit lands there you're fighting a 2v1. Reposition fights toward open river or mid-lane terrain.

playing.title: Hold Q for the slow, not poke
playing.detail: Q (Seismic Shard) steals her movement speed on impact — use it to stick to her for an E (Ground Slam) and auto, not as chip damage from range, since you can't out-trade her sustain at distance.

playing.title: Pop W before she commits W
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes' Armor and AD buff is your only damage window — activate it right as she leaps in with Harsh Lesson so the extra armor blunts her hit and the AD buff makes your response trade worth it.

playing.title: Save R for her Test of Spirit window
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force's knock-up interrupts her channel if she tries to isolate you with E away from minions — a 130s (level 6) cooldown means you only get this punish once early, so don't waste it diving.

playing.title: Last-hit from max range on E cooldown
playing.detail: When her E is down she has no way to force spirit damage from range, so this is your safest CS window — step up and farm aggressively instead of staying passive all lane.

playing.title: Track her Tentacle Smash charges
playing.detail: Q cooldown drops from 10s to 6s by level 5 — once she's spamming it for wave clear and empowered Tentacle damage, you lose any extended trade near terrain even with Sunfire online.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (909-game sample for this matchup); the mechanical reasoning and trade-window calls are my own read of the kit, not sourced from win-rate data.
